name: Nephilim
source:
On a fateful night a wanderer finds our mc (You), he decides to take us under his wing to train us for several years why though? find out!, After being gone for 10 years.. You return to your home village, now a young man hardened by years of rough training, you are now ready to follow your own path in life. Still a young man there's much growth to be had on your journey, through challenges, choices, friendships &  possibly even love.

Explore the world of Midomir, it's filled with intriques, dilemmas, and interesting people for you to meet!

Discover what it means to be a *Nephilim*

Will you give in to the powers of darkness.. Or will you become a symbol of hope?

[From [url=https://buuplays.itch.io/nephilim]itch.io[/url]]
